## Description

Combines Vector Error Correction Models (VECM) with Markov-switching regimes to model cointegrated coin baskets whose cointegration vector and speed of adjustment shift across economic states.

## Where it may fit

Macroeconomic regime transitions, commodity-currency cointegration pairs, structural market shifts.

## Vehicles

Global macro hedge funds, quantitative relative-value funds.

## Required data

Multi-variable time series pricing, macroeconomic regime indicators, lag order criteria.

## Caveats

Maximum likelihood estimation for MS-VECM models can suffer from local maxima and convergence issues.
